heroLede: I take things apart to see how they work, then build them back better.
heroBody: I'm a Security Analyst at Checkout.com, where security operations meets engineering. I investigate what happened, then build and automate so the next time is easier. After hours I'm working toward a CS master's at Georgia Tech and writing up what I learn here, usually with Storm asleep somewhere nearby.

aboutBody:
I'm Asad. I work in security operations, and I like knowing how the whole stack fits together: the software, the infrastructure, the cloud underneath it, and all the ways it can go wrong.

Most of my side projects start with a small question: how does this work, why did it break, could it be simpler? Usually that ends in a script, a tool, or a long evening of reading.

The Lab is where I keep what I learn. The name is a nod to *Steins;Gate*, one of my favourite anime: a small, messy lab where curious people try things just to see what happens.

And this is Storm, a fluffy tabby-and-white cat with a firm claim on any warm spot near my desk.

If you'd like to talk about something I've built or written, [say hello](mailto:contact@asad.atterkhan.com).
